I am an old man here in Mangochi, and I have been growing beans and other legumes on this small piece for many years. I do not have money to buy fertilizer from the shop for beans — the little coupon I sometimes get, I use it on my maize, not on beans. Beans do well on their own if the rains come, and I put some goat droppings and old maize stalks on the plot before planting, the way my father taught me. I use the seeds I kept from last harvest, I weed with my wife and my grown children, and I do not spray anything — the beans here do not need it.
